text:
Maya (People Ops): Heads-up — new Engineering Manager (Samir) starts Monday 09:00 PT. Quick pre-start checklist and ask for managers: can you confirm the items below before EOD Friday?

Maya (People Ops): Pre-start checklist (day-before):
```
- Laptop & power brick queued with IT (MacBook Pro M2)
- Okta invite + MFA setup link sent
- Slack + email provisioning done
- Notion access to /team/eng/manager-onboarding granted
- Calendar invites: 1:1 w/ director, skip-level, team kickoff (30m)
- Buddy assigned for week 1 (shadow & ops questions)
```

Alex (Eng): I can take buddy for week 1. Will do team kickoff + 1:1s scheduling.

Jordan (IT): Laptop queued, shipping scheduled Fri 10:30am. I'll DM tracking once label generated. Okta invite will go out after HR confirms start list (pending).

Maya (People Ops): Nice — Alex thanks. @Jordan please set device to 'dev image' and add Docker, VSCode, kubeconfig for dev cluster.

Jordan (IT): Will do. Quick note: kubeconfig provisioning requires SSO group add. @Priya can you confirm Samir needs access to 'eng-prod-read' or just 'eng-dev'?

Priya (People Ops): Samir gets eng-dev only for now. We'll escalate to eng-prod after 30-day review. Also adding that he should get manager level access to 1Password vault: managers/team-secrets.

Alex (Eng): For the first week agenda, here's a minimal schedule I use — can we lock these in?
```
Mon: 09:00 intro w/ Maya + ops, 10:00 team kickoff, 14:00 1:1 w/ director (30m)
Tue: buddy shadowing, infra walkthrough w/ platform (60m)
Wed: product deep-dive, cross-functional intro (30m)
Thu: goals conversation + draft 30/60/90 (60m)
Fri: skip-level intro + sync on OKRs
```

Maya (People Ops): Love it. Quick 30/60/90 template (short):
- 30d: ramp, meet stakeholders, ship small onboarding win
- 60d: lead a sprint planning, identify 1-2 improvements to infra/ops
- 90d: own roadmap chunk, quota on team hiring/mentorship

Alex (Eng): I'll bring a starter template to the Thu goals conversation.

onboard-bot: Reminder created: "Samir — prestart checklist" scheduled Fri 17:30 PT.

Maya (People Ops): Who-to-ask mapping (short):
- HR / payroll: Priya
- IT / hardware & access: Jordan
- Infra / kube access: Alex (cc: platform eng)
- Security / compliance: Security team channel (eng-security)

Priya (People Ops): I'll follow up on payroll + contract reminders. Also sending Samir a brief 15-minute "what to expect week 1" message with links.

Alex (Eng): One more ask: can we add a 30-min "product context" slot with the PM on Tue afternoon? Helps with prioritization.

Maya (People Ops): Added. Final ask: please react with :white_check_mark: when you confirm your items so I can close the checklist.

Jordan (IT): :white_check_mark: Laptop + dev image queued.

Alex (Eng): :white_check_mark: Buddy + schedule templates done.

Priya (People Ops): :white_check_mark: Payroll & 1Password done (pending Samir acceptance).

Maya (People Ops): Great — thanks team. I'll post the final onboarding doc and links in #new-hires and DM Samir the week-1 agenda.
